cases.name: Akbolto Prime
referenceLimitations: ON KILL THE BODY FOLLOWS THE BOLT, damaging anyone in its path and pinning the corpse to walls (wiki). It is a second damage source that only exists once something has died, and this engine has no ragdoll and no wall for it to pin against — so a bolt weapon fighting a crowd is understated by however much that corpse would have hit on the way past
